label: Lantas 1.8.0 development build
changes: Screen: the computer-use card now floats above every app and every full-screen Space, top-centre, so it no longer disappears when you go full screen in Safari or an editor.

Screen: the live preview is gone. You see only the card, its steps and the blue pointer; the agent sees a private, much denser labelled grid of the front window with every control boxed and numbered, and can zoom into a region when something is too small.

Screen: clicks and typing go through Accessibility first, so they land on the actual control, and the agent can target a named cell, a fraction of the window or an exact point. Models without vision skip the picture entirely.
Screen: captures the target window alone, without its shadow, so the grid, the boxes and the pointer line up with the window you are looking at.
